nextProjects.title: Upcoming Projects
nextProjects.description: Explore the next initiatives planned for the Fly Infinity ecosystem. Detailed information will be published as each project develops.
nextProjects.exchangeDescription: A future exchange initiative within the Fly Infinity ecosystem.
nextProjects.lotteryDescription: A proposed public prize-draw concept, subject to applicable laws, eligibility requirements and published rules. Any founder allocation remaining after the winner's prize is paid is planned to be directed to FIT backing.
nextProjects.payDescription: A public, decentralized payment gateway for businesses worldwide. Payment fees are allocated to FIT backing and developer rewards, supporting the FIT ecosystem and developer contributions.
nextProjects.dexDescription: A public, decentralized exchange where users worldwide can swap cryptocurrencies for other digital assets. All trading fees are directed to FIT backing, supporting its backing and price mechanism.
nextProjects.marketplaceDescription: A global digital marketplace connecting buyers and sellers. Fees are allocated to FIT backing and developer rewards, supporting both the FIT ecosystem and ongoing development.
